body:
Today the Show/Hide changes button only appears on a waiting proposal, and Preview doesn't appear on every design version.

## Asked for

- Every design version after the first has the Show/Hide changes button, which marks what changed compared with the version before it.
- Every design version has the other controls, such as Preview.

## Done when

- Viewing any version after the first offers Show/Hide changes, marking added, removed, changed and moved elements compared with the previous version.
- The first version has no Show/Hide changes button.
- Preview is offered on every version of a UI/UX design.

## Calls made

- Preview stays on the UI/UX tab only. Architecture diagrams have no screens to click through.
title: design versions: preview and changes on each
